verdict.rationale: Dispute and chargeback handling is a fair axis for a payments product, but the evidence pack never documents dispute evidence submission, dispute status, or outcomes for agent transactions. The only nearby material covers refunds through the standard Refunds API and MCP approval gates for refunds. Refunds are a different capability and earn no credit for a disputes story.

support.subject: As a developer, disputes and chargebacks on agent transactions can be handled via API — evidence submission, status, outcomes
